verdict.rationale: Enumerating models programmatically is a fair question for a model API provider, so the axis applies. However, no evidence item documents a models-listing endpoint. General OpenAI/Anthropic SDK compatibility does not establish that a list-models endpoint exists, and lifecycle notices posted in the updates changelog are human-readable announcements, not a programmatic catalog.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent enumerate the live model catalog programmatically via a documented models endpoint
